record_type_quote: We attempt to replicate the authors’ results and extend their analyses using both constrained estimation techniques and five additional years of data.

targets.title: Estimating lorenz curves using a dirichlet distribution.
targets.evidence_quote: For our first objective, we attempt a narrow replication of Chotikapanich and Griffiths (2002), hereafter CG, who propose using a Dirichlet distribution to model cumulative income share data.
targets.outcome_quote: Our narrow replication of CG verifies a majority of their results. However, we discover a few minor computational and presentational issues in CG. These issues do not affect CG’s qualitative conclusions. Our scientific replication extends the analysis from CG to constrained estimators and additional data.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The study combines reproduction of original data and a replication using five additional years. New-data comparisons agree for some findings and differ for others; the authors conclude only some qualitative results hold.

reasoning: Both original-data reanalysis and an explicit test in different country-year samples are reported; classified as replication because additional data retest the published findings. Only CG (2002) is a target; data and functional-form sources are not independent targets.
